title: Data quality checks in code
objectives: Turn expectations about data into checks that count failures
Report every failed check at once, not just the first
Decide which failures stop a load and which only warn

exercises.prompt: Check the orders batch: order_id is unique, amount isn't negative, and customer_id is present. Return one row per check that fails, with its name (order_id_unique, amount_not_negative, customer_id_present) as check_name and the number of bad rows as failures, in check_name order.
hints: The starter checks only one thing. Write one small query per check, each giving a name and a count.
For uniqueness, count the rows whose order_id appears more than once, or count(*) - count(DISTINCT order_id).
Join the three with UNION ALL and keep only the rows WHERE failures > 0.
